data.one_liner: An animated colorful progress bar widget supporting vertical and horizontal directions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable progress bar widget that smoothly animates from the latest value to a new value when state changes. It supports horizontal and vertical orientations, custom gradients, color changes based on values, and text displays.
use_when: You need a horizontal or vertical progress bar with built-in animations.
You want to dynamically change bar colors or display text based on current progress values.
avoid_when: You require complex circular or gauge-style progress charts.
You need non-linear or physics-based custom motion graphs.
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical layouts.
Smoothly animates progress value updates automatically.
Allows custom gradients, border radiuses, and threshold color changes.
weaknesses: Limited to linear progress bar shapes.
No built-in support for indeterminate loading animations.
